Perfect place for Business Lunch and Dinner
Mar 2017 • Business
I had a business lunch at this location couple of days ago and it was fantastic.

Location is a bit hard to get to because one's would have to go through the shop in the front to find the Elevator at the back to get to the Restaurant. Two trip if the party is more than 6 people.

Ambient. It is very cozy inside with amble rooms with great views of the busied streets cape below. The decor is very business like with several private rooms in the back for private dinning. Of course it has a sushi bar too at the front.😆

Services. The staffs are young and well trained to serve you thoroughly... no worries here. 

Foods. The menu is not very busy but instead very business like. There are typical Sashimi and Sushi, and set menu which is very accommodate for those that do not has the time. I personally chose the Tonkatsu Fried Pork Cutlets rice combo (see photo) and it also came with Miso soup and Chawanmushi... but the chawanmushi was a plain eggs with broth.. perhaps it was meant for the lunch set combo. But over all it was a good combo. 

Price. My order was $300,000 vnd which is about $13.30 usd.

Well. I will come back to try the other dishes on the menu soon enough.
 
Enjoy and Happy Traveling 😋

K 🖖

Lunch set like in Tokyo!
Dec 2015 • Solo
Admittedly my experience is limited, but overall positive.

I had lunch and I was provided what I believe is a shortened version of the menu, mainly presenting lunch sets. 

I chose an all time Japanese favorite: the fried mackerel. It came with plenty of side dishes and it was a good bite, not some sort of micro dish that sometimes you are offered in other places. The bill was around 14 USD, a bit more expensive than other lunch places. but still in the real of reasonableness.
